description_html:
Documentation


Specification 3D Model Application Instruction

 

Overview


This Dynamic Installation Art Kit is designed to help creators and art enthusiasts create exquisite interactive art pieces or dynamic mechanical devices, such as automata devices, tourbillon models, marble run models, and rotating display stands.



Kit Includes:

  • A variety of motors: Different models to meet varying load and speed requirements, ensuring your devices are both stable and versatile.
  • LED lights: Add visual appeal to your creations, producing unique lighting effects—especially suitable for display stands and interactive art installations.
  • Slip ring: Provide stable power transmission while supporting continuous 360-degree rotation, achieving seamless dynamic effects.
  • Magnetic connectors: Offer a creative way to connect and disconnect power with a snap, serving as both an electrical connector and a switch.
  • Motor speed controller: Pair with TT motors to easily adjust motor speed and precisely control the movement of your devices.
  • Power distribution board set: Connect switches, potentiometers, N20 motors, LED lights, slip rings, and magnetic connectors for flexible assembly and control.

Applications:

  • Automata devices: Create artistic automated mechanical devices, combining LED lighting and fine-tuned motor adjustments to showcase intricate motion patterns.
  • Tourbillon models: Design and craft elegant tourbillon mechanisms, achieving graceful rotation effects with speed controllers.
  • Marble run models: Use motors to drive automatic and continuous marble movement, making fun and engaging mechanical toys.
  • Rotating display stands: Add dynamic flair to your 3D-printed figures or art pieces, making your displays more captivating.
